## Statements & failure conditions

### OPN-001 — Mathematical postulates for discrete cosmological actualization

No postulate set has been given for what discrete actualization IS mathematically - what is specified at the boundary, over what manifold, and how the specification connects to the subsequent evolution governed by CRE-005.

*Risk if false:* Without postulates the programme cannot compute, and every belt claim below remains prose. This gates ROADMAP items 2, 3 and 4.

### OPN-002 — Model of rapid metric actualization during Day Four

Whether the Day Four event is representable as rapid metric expansion, as an alternative mechanism, or as a process presently unknown, is left open by the position paper (section 4).

*Risk if false:* PHY-001 is the load-bearing physical hypothesis of the programme; without a model it remains an assertion that something happened.

### OPN-003 — Field equations compatible with general relativity

What formulation of gravitational dynamics holds across the actualization boundary, and in what sense general relativity is retained, suspended, or recovered as a limit.

*Risk if false:* Without this the programme cannot connect the actualized initial configuration to any present-epoch observation quantitatively.

### OPN-004 — Quantitative model of cosmological redshift

A quantitative account of the distance-redshift relation under created geometry plus subsequent evolution, reproducing the observed relation across the measured range.

*Risk if false:* Redshift is the primary observable through which cosmic history is read. ACC-002 and ACC-003 have no mechanism until this exists.

### OPN-005 — CMB implications and the acoustic peak structure

Whether the blackbody spectrum, isotropy, and acoustic peak structure of the CMB admit an account under actualized initial conditions plus subsequent ordinary law.

*Risk if false:* The peaks are the rival's strongest quantitative ground. Silence here is the single largest gap between CAC and a competitive cosmological model.

### OPN-006 — Large-scale structure formation

Whether observed large-scale structure - the filamentary web, the correlation function, cluster abundance evolution - follows from an actualized initial configuration under ordinary gravitational law.

*Risk if false:* If structure must be specified rather than grown, the maturity principle absorbs an increasing share of the explanatory work and the programme's content declines toward 'it was made that way', which forbids nothing.

### OPN-007 — Observational discriminators distinguishing CAC from LCDM

At least one observation that CAC forbids and LCDM permits, or that CAC permits and LCDM forbids, stated with its evaluation protocol in advance.

*Risk if false:* This is the whole question. Until one exists the programme is unappraisable in Lakatos's sense and the appraisal verdict cannot move off UNAPPRAISED, however much belt machinery accumulates.

### OPN-009 — Light travel time from cosmological distances

Under CRE-004, what accounts for light presently arriving from sources at cosmological distance. Axiom 4's Earth-frame reading and section 4's rapid actualization gesture at an answer; neither supplies one.

*Risk if false:* This is the first objection any competent reader raises. A programme that cannot state its position is not yet in the conversation.

### OPN-010 — Processes observed in transit

Distant observations record not merely arrived light but PROCESSES WITH INTERNAL DURATION: Type Ia supernova light curves time-dilated as (1+z), the SN 1987A ring light-echo geometry, quasar variability, binary pulsar spin-down. A created-in-transit account must explain the observed internal consistency of processes apparently unfolding at distance, not only the arrival of the light. Per EXT-004 the account must additionally DECLARE, per class of record, whether the recorded process is actual in TRT's sense.

*Risk if false:* This is the sharpest form of the omphalos objection and bears directly on CRE-007's claim that operational completeness does not entail deception. If unanswerable, CRE-007 fails and the theological warrant is undercut by the programme's own doctrine of God.
